unit.title: Halves, Patterns and Data
unit.blurb: Finding halves of shapes and amounts, continuing repeating patterns, and reading simple pictograms.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Find half of a shape or a small amount, and continue repeating patterns.

O2.t: Sort objects and read simple pictograms and block graphs.

p: A **half** is one of **two equal parts**. Cut a pizza into two parts the same size: each part is a half. Half of 6 apples is 3 apples.
If you cut a cake into a big piece and a small piece, they are not halves.
A **pattern** repeats. 🔴🔵🔴🔵🔴… Find the part that repeats, then say what comes next.

p: We can **sort** objects into groups that are the same in some way – by colour, shape or size.
A **pictogram** uses pictures to show how many. Each picture is one thing. The longest row has the **most**.
